identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase Ib Clinical Study of CD19 CAR-T Expressing IL-7 and CCL19 Combined With Tislelizumab in the Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma

primaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with adverse events. Frequencies of toxicities based on the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE), version 5.0 will be tabulated.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Measured from start of treatment until 28 days after last dose.

primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of CR and PR subjects will be assessed at 3 months post-infusion.

secondaryOutcomes.description: To measure the duration of response over a follow-up period of 24 months.
OS will be assessed from the first chimeric antigen receptor T cells (CAR-T) given to death or last follow-up.
